name: us021-state-corrupt
description: T021 [US2]: reconcile a three-story specification to completion, corrupt the recorded run-state document to invalid JSON, then reconcile again. contracts/run-state.md §3 row 'State file unreadable, not valid JSON, or missing a required field': the second run must still be a full reconcile — it re-records a fresh, valid state document rather than trusting or repairing the corrupt one (§8 invariant S8).
